findings.title: Unicode attachment filenames trigger HTTP 500 ByteString crash, global message_id index causes cross-identity dedup collisions, and delta triggers omit spam/triage fields

findings.summary: `GET /v1/attachments/:id` placed raw non-ASCII attachment filenames directly into `Content-Disposition: filename="..."`, throwing a Workers runtime `TypeError: Cannot convert argument to a ByteString` (HTTP 500) on any UTF-8 filename (e.g. German umlauts); `messages_message_id_idx` enforced uniqueness globally rather than per `(identity_address, message_id)` (dropping legitimate multi-recipient messages sharing a `Message-ID`); `DELETE /v1/addresses/:address` called Cloudflare Email Routing deletion on `alias`/`external` rows; and D1 `mailbox_changes` triggers omitted `spam`/`triage_*` while firing spurious revisions on internal `drafted_at`/`spam_checked_at` updates.

findings.title: MTA-STS middleware fails open on unmanaged mta-sts.* hosts, skips securityHeaders, and inline passkey HTML uses unsafe-inline script CSP

findings.fixed_by: lmail-lead (claude-opus-4-6, lmail-lead session 9ce103f8-523d-4541-be37-a1c6ef728de0 of 2026-11-27; fix log fix-logs/20261127-004500-all-open-findings-lmail-lead.md)

findings.summary: `isolateMtaStsHosts` ran before `securityHeaders`, returned headerless responses, and called `next()` whenever an `mta-sts.*` hostname was not in static `MANAGED_DOMAINS_JSON` (exposing the full `/v1/*` and `/auth/*` surface on dynamically added or misrouted `mta-sts.*` hosts); meanwhile `/auth/native/start` used `script-src 'unsafe-inline'` instead of a per-request CSP nonce and responses lacked default `Cache-Control: no-store`.

findings.summary: In `ios/LukaMail`, `MailHTMLDocument` stripped only `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, and `<embed>` before rendering email HTML in `WKWebView` (leaving `<base>`, `<meta http-equiv="refresh">`, `<svg>`/`<foreignObject>`, `<form>`, `<video>`/`<audio>`/`<source>`, `<link>`, and `srcdoc=` intact), `MailStore` interpolated unsanitized attachment `contentType` into `data:` URLs (including `image/svg+xml`), `MailWebView` accepted `http://` navigations and lacked explicit `javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically = false`, and `temporaryFileURL()` did not strip `..` segments.

findings.title: Apple keychain/cache lifecycle and Rust CLI redirect, terminal-escape, and credential-file permissions hardening
findings.source: Apple clients, WKWebView, and Rust CLI review of 2026-11-27, item SEC-20261127-002001-SYS-002

findings.summary: In `cli/src/main.rs`, `reqwest::Client` followed HTTP redirects by default (risking `Authorization: Bearer` header forwarding or SSRF on `mta-sts` checks), printed untrusted email subjects/bodies directly to stdout without stripping ANSI/OSC/BiDi terminal control sequences, and wrote `credentials.json` via non-atomic `fs::write` before `chmod 600`. In `ios/LukaMail`, `KeychainStore` defaulted to `.afterFirstUnlock` (allowing iCloud Keychain backup sync of device tokens), `MailCache` stored cached bodies without `.completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication` or `.isExcludedFromBackup`, and `NativeAuthSession` did not enforce host/scheme parity on `ASWebAuthenticationSession` callbacks.
